Indian Navy receives first next-generation missile vessel

Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL) has laid the keel for the first of a new generation of missile vessels for the Indian Navy. The vessel is designed to be a next-generation missile carrier. This development marks a step in the Indian Navy's modernization efforts.
